reason: Independent-oracle requirement received after the primary database gate and before any family evaluation.
audit_scope: Every applicable connected Graph Atlas graph on at most six vertices, plus C5 and Petersen microfixtures.
second_oracle: Enumerate cycle edge sets as 2-regular connected nonempty edge subsets, then solve weighted set cover by exact dynamic programming over covered-edge masks.
independence: This does not call networkx.simple_cycles, scipy.optimize.milp, or the primary exact_scc function.
pass_condition: Every second-oracle shortest-cover value equals the already appended primary-oracle value; C5=5 and Petersen=21.
stop_rule: Any mismatch or resource failure yields GATE_FAIL and leaves the family locked.
